name: era-advance
description: Drive play into era 4 (2001), the final era, so its rendering/gameplay routines run, and pixel-validate them against MAME.
_grounding: 0xAD04 holds the RAW era 0..4 (not packed); era 4 = 0x04, confirmed under MAME (neg control 0x40 corrupts PLAY_ACTIVE). Direct held poke is coherent+stable (era held, PLAY_ACTIVE=0xFF, actors churning 500 frames); the kill-count path cannot advance the era without an aimed boss kill. See scratchpad/era4-recipe.md.
